title: Laurdag
about: One piece for every biome, open or underground: it plays as written everywhere, so every fader is 0 dB by default. The roles say what each lane does, so a player that wants to may lean a piece towards its surroundings; the hints are suggestions, not part of the mix.

roles.foundation: bass and the left-hand figure, the pulse: keep it
roles.bed: sustained pad: the first to smear under a cave reverb
roles.sparkle: high, struck colour (music box): shares the top with the birdsong outdoors
